options.name: action
options.description: STAGE will transfer the upgrade bundle to the nodes but will not initiate the upgrade procedure. UPGRADE will initiate the upgrade procedure.

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: concurrent_size
options.description: Number of nodes that can be upgraded in parallel. This parameter is only valid for UPGRADE requests.

options.name: failure_rate
options.description: The failure rate of LCM batch job. failure_rate = failed nodes count / total nodes count. This parameter is only valid for UPGRADE requests.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for host folder upgrade, the default value is 21600 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
